source: Potapov V, Ong JL, Kucera RB, Langhorst BW, Bilotti K, Pryor JM, Cantor EJ, Canton B, Knight TF, Evans TC Jr, Lohman GJS (2018) Comprehensive profiling of four base overhang ligation fidelity by T4 DNA ligase and application to DNA assembly. ACS Synth Biol 7(11):2665-2674. Measured values taken from the reference data-analysis repository for that method (NEB / potapovneb ligase-fidelity workflow), b4 4-base-overhang example summary table.

measurement.assay: multiplexed ligation assay on the b4 substrate (four randomized overhang bases flanked by fixed TCC/GGA), products read by PacBio SMRT sequencing
measurement.dataset: b4 example dataset of the official workflow repository; raw reads at NCBI SRA PRJNA894239 (runs SRR22044163, SRR22044164)
measurement.condition: NOT VERIFIED: the temperature/time of this example run is not stated in the source repository. The 2018 paper's default presentation condition is 25 C for 18 h; do not assume that value for these numbers.
measurement.fidelity_definition: correct Watson-Crick ligation events / total ligation events observed for that overhang
measurement.counts: raw observed ligation events (not normalized to 100000 events)
measurement.caveat: For the 16 self-complementary overhangs the correct-ligation count is counted twice in the source summary (the self-pair appears twice in the 256x256 matrix), which slightly inflates their fidelity values relative to non-palindromic overhangs.

rank_definition: fidelity_rank 1 = highest measured fidelity among the 256 four-base overhangs
notes: All 256 canonical 4-mers (A/C/G/T) are present with per-overhang measured fidelity. palindromic and self_complementary are equivalent for a 4-mer overhang: both mean reverse_complement(overhang) == overhang, i.e. the overhang can pair with a second copy of itself. The 16 such 4-mers are unusable as single junctions in one-pot Golden Gate assembly.

structural_rules.rule: A 4-nt overhang is palindromic/self-complementary iff it equals its own reverse complement; there are 4^2 = 16 such 4-mers. Exclude them from any overhang set.

AATT.notes: Self-complementary palindrome: the overhang can ligate to another copy of itself, so it must never be used as a junction in one-pot Golden Gate assembly. Its correct-ligation count is doubled in the source table because the self-pair appears twice in the matrix.
